mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 7.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate revenue expectations decline.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 98.0 indicates a slowing manufacturing sector that precedes market corrections, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansions when INDPRO < 98.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts Federal Reserve tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A real GDP level (GDPC1) above 13500 billion dollars indicates robust economic expansion that sustains corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 > 13500, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 7.5% and decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 134000 thousand indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5% and PAYEMS < 134000, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%), a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below 410000 million dollars signals reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% and RSAFS < 410000, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.
